feeds.title: Knitting Only Socks
feeds.description: I am a wife, the mother of four grown sons, and nana to five grandchildren. I work part-time as a librarian/ archivist at a university library. I enjoy knitting socks, hats, mittens and other items for charity, reading, hand quilting, growing old-fashioned flowers, and bird watching.

feeds.title: sock-crazy
feeds.description: I learned to knit as a child but abandoned it for more childlike activities. I started again as an adult and knit almost every day. Socks are my favorite thing to knit but I also am hooked on shawls, fingerless mitts, hats, and cowls. I like smaller projects that can be finished in a reasonable length of time.

feeds.title: Winwick Mum
feeds.description: An award-winning creative lifestyle blog featuring the hugely popular free Sockalong sock-knitting tutorials for beginners - let the fun begin! I'm Christine. I live in Winwick, a small village in Cheshire, and this is where I write about what makes me happy: my family, knitting, gardening, home-making, enjoying the outdoors.
